title: Co-DSL: Human-LLM Co-design of Reusable Spatial Concepts for Layout Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Co-DSL, a framework in which users and LLMs co-design reusable spatial concepts for layout generation. In the first stage, our system allows users to create a library of personalized operations. To add a concept, a user provides a description, which the LLM converts into an initial implementation. The user can then observe the concept's execution behavior over example scenarios and provide lightweight feedback to the LLM, which revises the concept's implementation logic. In the second stage, given a library, an LLM can author a layout program that meets a new layout request from a user. Executing a layout program instantiates a concept-graph, a declarative composition of library concepts. In this way, we require the LLM only to specify which concepts should hold, while we use a solver to search for a layout that satisfies them. Across five spatial layout domains, we find that Co-DSL libraries let LLMs capture layout patterns

translated_title: Co-DSL：人类与大语言模型协同设计可复用空间概念以实现布局生成
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Co-DSL，这是一个用户与大语言模型（LLM）共同设计可复用空间概念、并将其用于布局生成的框架。在第一阶段，我们的系统允许用户创建个性化的操作库。要添加一个概念，用户只需提供一段描述，LLM会将其转换为初始实现。随后，用户可以在示例场景中观察该概念的执行行为，并向LLM提供轻量级的反馈，LLM据此对概念的实现逻辑进行修订。在第二阶段，基于已建立的概念库，LLM可以编写一个布局程序来满足用户提出的新布局请求。执行布局程序时会实例化一个概念图，即库中各概念的声明式组合。通过这种方式，我们只要求LLM指定哪些概念应当成立，而由求解器搜索满足这些概念的布局。在五个空间布局领域中，我们发现Co-DSL概念库能够让LLM捕捉布局模式。
tldr: Co-DSL提出了一种人机协同设计框架：用户通过描述与轻量反馈与大语言模型共同迭代构建可复用的空间概念库，生成布局时LLM只需声明应满足哪些概念，再由求解器搜索具体布局，从而在多个空间布局领域实现个性化的布局生成。
